xlw.the_workbook_matches_the_model_sav: The workbook matches the model. Save edits in the workbook and they appear here (checked every second).
xlw.new_rows_get_their_id_after_re_exp: New rows get their id after re-export.
xlw.rewrite_the_workbook_from_the_mode: Rewrite the workbook from the model; your columns and sheets are kept
xlw.preview_model_unchanged_workbook_i: preview, model unchanged · workbook is watched
xlw.not_in_book_tip: These model elements have no row in the workbook. Tick "Delete rows missing from the workbook" below to delete them when you apply.
xlw.new_columns_project_parameters_tic: New columns → project parameters (tick to create)
xlw.no_cell_changes_the_workbook_match: No cell changes: the workbook matches the model.
xlw.fix_the_errors_in_the_workbook_and: Fix the errors in the workbook and save it
xlw.close_the_workbook_and_export_it_a: Close the workbook and export it again: new rows have no id yet
xlw.nothing_is_applied_while_there_are: Nothing is applied while there are errors
xlw.the_model_changed_after_the_previe: The model changed after the preview: the workbook was compared again, review and apply
xlw.book_changed_reread: The workbook was saved after the preview: it was read again, review and apply
xlw.conflicts_note: {n} cells changed in both the workbook and the model after the export. The model value is kept unless you choose the workbook value for a cell.
xlw.sheet_missing: Sheet {sheet} is missing from the workbook (renamed or deleted); its rows were not compared.
xlw.sheet_look_alike: Sheet {found} looks like {sheet} and was not read — rename it to {sheet}.
xlw.sheet_look_alike_many: Sheets {found} look like {sheet} and were not read — rename one of them to {sheet}.
xlw.synchronize_tip: Read the workbook again and rebuild this list. The model is not changed.
xlw.book_locked: The workbook is open in another program. Close it there, then try again.
xlw.no_book: No linked workbook yet. Export to XLSX spreadsheet first, or use Import from XLSX spreadsheet.
xlw.model_newer_note: {n} cells were changed in the model after the export. The model values are kept; the workbook still has the old ones.
xlw.skipped_note: {n} cells or rows have a problem and are skipped; everything else still applies.
xlw.sheets_not_carried: Sheets not carried over: {names}. The old workbook is kept as {path}
xlw.cells_not_carried: {count} user cells of removed rows were not carried over. The old workbook is kept as {path}
xlw.synced_copy: The workbook is open in another program. A refreshed copy was written and is linked now: {path}
xlw.load_running: A workbook is already being read; wait for it to finish or cancel it.
xlw.load_cancelled: Reading cancelled, the model is unchanged.
xlw.reload_cancelled: Re-reading cancelled; Apply reads the workbook again first.
xlw.reload_locked: The workbook is being saved by another program; trying again shortly.
xlw.export_running: An export is already running; wait for it to finish or cancel it.
xlw.export_cancelled: Export cancelled, no file was written.
xlw.sync_none: No workbook is linked to this model yet. Export the model to XLSX spreadsheet to create one, then edit it and sync back.
xlw.scope_not_extended: Applied, but the new rows were not added to the selection scope.
xlw.new_rows_not_in_book: {n} new rows were not added to the workbook, export again.
xl.msg.row_already_created_as_x_export_a: row already created as {}, export the workbook again
xlw.applied_not_refreshed: Applied, but the view was not refreshed:
xlw.delete_confirm: {n} elements will be deleted. Click the red button again to confirm:
xlw.error_resave_note: The workbook is read again after its next save.
xlw.mass_delete_warning: Mass deletion: more than 20 % of a sheet, or a whole category, would be removed. A filtered or cut sheet looks like this.
xlw.prop_refused_all: Cannot be added: every row with a value was refused (rows {rows})
xlw.prop_refused_some: Rows {rows} were refused: their values are not added
